# Iqra Rehman

> Senior WordPress, Shopify and Webflow developer based in Islamabad, Pakistan. 3+ years of experience and 50+ websites delivered for clients in Pakistan, Dubai (UAE), the United Kingdom, Germany and the United States. Available for freelance and remote work.

## Services

- WordPress development: Elementor Pro, Divi, WPBakery, custom themes with ACF
- Shopify and WooCommerce online stores
- Webflow websites with CMS
- Figma to code (pixel-accurate, responsive)
- Website speed optimization and Core Web Vitals (typical PageSpeed score 90+)
- Technical SEO: schema markup, site structure, sitemaps, crawlability
- Custom WordPress plugin development and API integrations
- Website maintenance and support
- Website migration (host, domain or platform)
- Domain, hosting, DNS, SSL and business email setup

## Typical timelines

- Landing page: 1 day
- Standard business website: 3 to 5 days
- Online store: 5 to 8 days
- Speed fix: 1 to 2 days
